tasks.title: Implement the requested change
tasks.spec: Implement the change described by the coordinator in this project's working tree. Keep the scope focused, run relevant checks, and report a summary, evidence, and a handoff describing changed files and remaining limitations. Do not publish or merge changes.

tasks.title: Verify the implementation
tasks.spec: Read the implementation handoff and run the relevant tests against that code version. Do not modify source files. Report commands, results, and failures with evidence. Treat a failed required check as failure.

tasks.title: Review the implementation
tasks.spec: Review the implementation for correctness, regressions, and missing coverage. Do not modify source files. Report evidence and an approved or changes_requested review verdict, with actionable findings when changes are needed.
